author: GamingBolt
description:
Out of nowhere, Rockstar has dropped tons of new information for Grand Theft Auto 6. Pre-orders go live at midnight local time on June 25th; the Ultimate Edition has finally been revealed; and lo and behold, it actually put the prices out front for everyone to get acclimated to before really diving in. 

There is a lot to go through, so without further ado, let's jump into the most important information, starting with...
title: GTA 6 - 15 NEW Details You Probably Missed

author: GamingBolt
description:
The Steam Machine is finally available to reserve, and while that price tag is still fresh in everyone’s minds, there’s a lot more to Valve’s solution to a living-room PC/console hybrid than that. 

Thankfully, we’re here to tell you all the important stuff you need to keep in mind if you’re thinking about getting your hands on one for some nice gaming sessions from your couch. 

There’s a lot of ground to cover from the specs its shipping with to what you can expect when you try to run some of the latest and greatest titles to grace our screens in recent years. Join us as we take you through everything we think you should know before you decide to drop a significant chunk of your hard-earned cash on this one.
title: Steam Machine  - 15 NEW Details To Know Before You Buy
